ratings_why.fun: One shared pile with three levers (more deaths, bigger entries, more Fruit) gives real cross-links: Renderer moving a carry's buffs, Amanita feeding Old Fingers, Bootlace's run fighting your own burials.
ratings_why.distinct: The overnight pile that empties each turn and Fruit on any tribe are fresh, but the core is a familiar sacrifice-and-deathrattle tribe.

verdict_why: Ludwig's wording needs one fix and a few cards do one obvious job; the engine itself is sound and shouldn't be cut back.

points.text: Ludwig 'gains its stats' doesn't say printed or full, and the tribe distinguishes the two everywhere else. It decides how big the White-Rot Renderer plus Ludwig combo is; say which.
Hired Mute is plain gold on a threshold Spores reach for free. Give it a hook into the pile, like gold for each burial that turn, so it becomes a Wake decision instead of filler.
Golden Warden Amanita only raises Bristle. Letting the golden destroy every unit next to her (diagonals too) would make her a real chase card for the Burst build.
Rootbinder is blank on a Guild-only board. Letting it also give Fruit to Spores beside it would keep the splash role and add an odd Spore-carry line.
Moss-Bier Bearer counts only fight deaths; letting burials count too would tie it to Sexton and make placement around the burial slot a real puzzle.

standouts.why: Turns a dying carry's buffs into a feast for every Fruit unit: the off-label redistribution Johnny lives for.
Kills her neighbours before a blow lands, so death text, Old Fingers, Inkcap and Moss-Bier all fire from one placement.
The best payoff needs an unbroken run while your own burials keep cutting it, which makes every burial a board-shape choice.

weakest.why: Plain conditional gold that Spores satisfy without trying.
A small +1/+1 per neighbouring death; does one job and doesn't touch the pile.
Dead text unless you're mixed with another tribe.

flags.note: Golden Mourner of Three Rains keeps the whole pile, so every Fruit unit drinks a growing pile each turn.
Ludwig plus White-Rot Renderer: one burial of a pumped carry goes onto Ludwig whole and into the pile at full value, which Ludwig's own Fruit then drinks too.
Bootlace plus two Sealbearers stacks four Fruit on one carry; with Mourner and Inkcap this is the likeliest runaway.
'Gains its stats' doesn't say printed or full.
